name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Formulate MaxCut on the graph with edges [(0, 1), (0, 2), (0, 4), (0, 5), (1, 5), (1, 6), (2, 3), (2, 5), (3, 4), (3, 6), (4, 5), (4, 6)] as a QUBO with dimod and solve it with SimulatedAnnealingSampler from dwave-samplers. Verify against brute force. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
